verdict.rationale: The Skills ecosystem runs inside Claude Code, which documents connecting to hundreds of external tools via MCP: "MCP servers give Claude Code access to your tools, databases, and APIs." Claude Code plugins, the distribution unit for skills, explicitly bundle MCP servers alongside skills, agents and hooks and install them as one unit. Admins can also restrict which servers run. missing for 10: the MCP capability belongs to the Claude Code host rather than to Skills themselves, no configuration or transport detail for adding servers, no hands-on corroboration of MCP tool use with skills.
